about: Remote fields another party wrote, each with the result of the rule (redact.Remote in Go, readRemoteText in packages/contracts/src/remote-text.ts). A readable row prints as its printed; a row that is not readable prints as the not-readable marker. Every row comes in its raw form and in its Go-quoted form (-quoted). No printed holds any of its row's secrets; each secret is in its row's field. A row with a repeat writes its field with {repeat} where repeat.part stands repeat.count times over, and both replayers write it out before they read the row, so a field nested thousands of references deep, or one as long as the longest field the rule reads, stays one short line here. Every credential here is made up.
not_readable: (not printed: the answer's words hold a URL the rule cannot read as clean)
